wiki_article: "SEMANTIC COLLAPSE AS COMEDY: An Analytical Framework for "FUCKING THE OFFICE"" is a 3,632-word theoretical paper by Lee Sharks, dated 2026-02-03. "FUCKING THE OFFICE" presents itself as absurdist performance art: a complete restaging of the sitcom The Office using only profanity. However, rigorous analysis reveals it as a sophisticated experiment in minimal semiotics, canonical pattern recognition, and audience-completion mechanics. The work is classified under the PHILOLOGICAL semantic family within the Crimson Hexagonal Archive. It was removed from Zenodo on June 19, 2026 and is preserved through Alexanarch.
